name: io.github.callobuzz/cob-rag-mcp
title: cob-rag-mcp
description: Give any MCP client a business's own knowledge base from a self-hosted cob-rag-engine.

environmentVariables.name: COB_RAG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of your cob-rag-engine, for example https://rag.example.com

environmentVariables.name: COB_RAG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A cob-rag-engine key: a knowledge-base key (ck_) reaches only that knowledge base

environmentVariables.name: COB_RAG_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true to offer only the tools that read
